title: Senior Software Engineer at Phaidra
description_review: Senior Software Engineer role at Phaidra developing reinforcement learning and AI-powered control systems for industrial facilities. Platform transforms static heuristic-driven plant operations into autonomous learning agents. Remote US role working on production ML systems.
pros: Senior engineering role centered on autonomous AI agents and production automation
Modern architecture tackling complex distributed control and sensor data pipelines
Proven production AI mission aligns with applied AI and agent engineering profile
cons: Industrial automation / RL domain rather than banking, fintech, or enterprise Java services
US remote location limitation stated in posting
Python/C++/RL control systems stack rather than Java/Spring Boot microservices

title: ML Engineer at Trunk Tools, Inc.
description_review: ML Engineer position at Trunk Tools building production-ready AI agents and multi-agent orchestration for construction operations. Series B funded ($70M total) with competitive $183k USD compensation. Role owns search, retrieval, and multi-agent coordination platform.
pros: Direct match with multi-agent orchestration, search, and retrieval agent systems
Strong compensation ($183,000 USD) at a high-growth Series B AI startup
Platform-level engineering ownership over multi-agent workflows and core AI platform
cons: ML/Python heavy AI stack without Java or Spring Boot microservices
Construction tech industry rather than banking, fintech, or enterprise systems
Requires pure ML/search engineering focus rather than enterprise SWE modernization

title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Backend Developer role at Proxify network building scalable web applications with Node.js and Nest.js. Involves REST/GraphQL APIs, TypeScript, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, and auth systems. Remote position aligned with CET (+/- 3 hours) timezone.
pros: Senior backend focus with 5+ years experience and compatible CET timezone
Strong TypeScript, REST APIs, and relational/NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) match
Nest.js enterprise architecture mirrors Spring Boot patterns (DI, decorators, modularity)
cons: Requires 5+ years Node.js and 3+ years Nest.js as primary stack rather than Java/Spring
Freelance talent network model rather than direct enterprise employment

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Cloud Engineer role at Proxify managing enterprise Azure environments, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines. Requires 5+ years experience in VNets, ExpressRoute, and zero-trust security. Remote position in CET (+/- 3 hours) timezone.
pros: Senior role handling enterprise cloud infrastructure and container orchestration
cons: Pure DevOps/Cloud infrastructure role, weak fit per candidate profile guidance
No backend application development, Java, Spring Boot, or microservices coding
Specialized in Azure network engineering and landing zones rather than software development

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Data Engineer role at Proxify focusing on Azure SQL Database, Data Factory, ETL development, and pipeline orchestration. Requires 5+ years in data engineering and advanced SQL tuning. Remote contract role matching CET (+/- 3 hours).
pros: Senior role involving data modeling, complex SQL, and data pipeline architecture
cons: Pure Data Engineering / ETL / Data Warehousing role rather than software engineering
No Java, Spring Boot, microservices, or API development
Focus is dedicated to Azure Data Factory, governance, and reporting pipelines
